name: merlink-harness
description: Local-first narrative harness for building a story with an AI agent

scripts.verify:ci: node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import fs from 'node:fs'; import { execSync } from 'node:child_process'; const wf = fs.readFileSync('.github/workflows/ci.yml', 'utf8'); const df = fs.readFileSync('Dockerfile', 'utf8'); const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')); const checkDocker = (txt, hasLock) => (txt.includes('npm ci') || txt.includes('package-lock.json') || !hasLock || !txt.includes('pnpm install --frozen-lockfile')) ? 'P6S1-C' : 'OK'; assert.equal(checkDocker(df, fs.existsSync('pnpm-lock.yaml') && !fs.existsSync('package-lock.json')), 'OK', 'P6S1-P/F2: Dockerfile must use pnpm-lock.yaml and frozen-lockfile'); assert.equal(checkDocker('RUN npm ci', false), 'P6S1-C', 'phase6_sprint1_deep0-F2: npm ci without package-lock must fail with P6S1-C'); const reqDeps = ['pkg-config', 'libssl-dev', 'libgtk-3-dev', 'libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev', 'libsoup-3.0-dev', 'librsvg2-dev', 'patchelf']; const checkDeps = (txt) => reqDeps.every((d) => txt.includes(d)) ? 'OK' : 'P6S1-N'; assert.equal(checkDeps(wf), 'OK', 'P6S1-N/F1: workflow must declare and check required platform dependencies'); assert.equal(checkDeps('steps: []'), 'P6S1-N', 'phase6_sprint1_deep0-F1: missing platform dependencies must fail with P6S1-N'); assert.ok(wf.includes('pnpm install --frozen-lockfile') && wf.includes('MERLINK_TEST_TEMP_ROOT') && wf.includes('MERLINK_TEST_DB_PATH') && wf.includes('CARGO_TARGET_DIR'), 'P6S1-P: CI uses pnpm lockfile and disposable test DB/target'); assert.ok(!/app-data\/merlink|sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{16,}|Bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._-]{16,}|secrets\./.test(wf), 'P6S1-N: workflow contains no production DB path or secret'); for (const s of ['build', 'dev', 'start', 'typecheck', 'lint', 'test']) assert.equal(typeof pkg.scripts[s], 'string', 'P6S1-B: required script ' + s); const checkGate = (baseOk, predOk) => (!baseOk || !predOk) ? 'CONTRACT_BLOCKED' : 'OK'; assert.equal(checkGate(true, false), 'CONTRACT_BLOCKED', 'phase6_sprint1_deep0-F0: missing predecessor'); assert.equal(checkGate(false, true), 'CONTRACT_BLOCKED', 'phase6_sprint1_deep0-F0: baseline drift'); execSync('git merge-base --is-ancestor ddda30cd3c842113599c7bfb7d0e221936330428 HEAD'); const lineage = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('tests/fixtures/lineage.json', 'utf8')); const acceptedLineage = new Set([lineage.baseline.sha, lineage.baseline.legacySha, ...lineage.acceptedCommits.map((entry) => entry.sha)]); assert.ok(acceptedLineage.has('cc6fe79511e4349b5fa22815d4d7a06ccc4cfad2'), 'phase6_sprint1_deep0-F0: predecessor gate must be recorded in the lineage manifest'); console.log('P6S1 verification passed: P6S1-P, P6S1-N, P6S1-B, phase6_sprint1_deep0-F0..F2');"
